misconceptions.name: can 后的动词加了 s
misconceptions.why: 看到主语是三单就给动词加 s，没注意前面有 can。
misconceptions.move: 把主语换成 I、they 再读：can 后的动词变不变？can 后永远用原形。

misconceptions.name: 给 can 本身加了 s
misconceptions.why: 把“三单加 s”用到了情态动词 can 上。
misconceptions.move: 问：说过 He cans 吗？情态动词没有人称变化。

misconceptions.name: can 后面多加了 to
misconceptions.why: 受 want to、like to 影响，以为两个动词之间都要加 to。
misconceptions.move: 对比：want to play / can play，让学生说出哪些词后面不加 to。

misconceptions.name: 三单主语后动词没加 s
misconceptions.why: 汉语里“他去”“我去”的“去”一样，动词不随主语变。
misconceptions.move: 圈出主语，问：是他、她、它或一个人吗？是就给动词加 s 或 es。

misconceptions.name: 该加 es 的只加了 s
misconceptions.why: 没记住以 o、s、x、ch、sh 结尾的动词加 es。
misconceptions.move: 列出 o、s、x、ch、sh 结尾的词，让学生当场加 es：goes、does、watches、washes、fixes。

misconceptions.name: by 后面加了冠词
misconceptions.why: 把 take the bus 里的 the 带进了 by bus。
misconceptions.move: 板书两个固定说法：by bus / take the bus，by 后面直接跟交通工具。

misconceptions.name: take 后面漏了冠词
misconceptions.why: 把 by bus 的说法搬到了 take 后面。
misconceptions.move: take 后是“乘坐一辆车”：take a bus / take the subway，冠词不能少。

misconceptions.name: Don't 后直接接形容词
misconceptions.why: 汉语“别迟到”里“迟到”像动词，就把 late 当动词用。
misconceptions.move: 问：late 是动词吗？形容词要靠 be：Be quiet. → Don't be late.

misconceptions.name: because 和 so 连用
misconceptions.why: 汉语习惯说“因为……所以……”。
misconceptions.move: 规定：because 和 so 只留一个；让学生把句子分别用 because、so 各说一遍。

misconceptions.name: 正在发生的事用了一般现在时
misconceptions.why: 汉语动词没有时态变化，没注意 Listen! 提示事情正在发生。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 Listen!、Look!、now，问：这件事是不是此刻正在发生？

misconceptions.name: 进行时漏了 be
misconceptions.why: 汉语“在唱歌”里没有和 be 对应的字。
misconceptions.move: 板书公式 am/is/are + 动词-ing，让学生先找 be，再找 -ing。

misconceptions.name: be 后面用了动词原形
misconceptions.why: 记得要用 be，却忘了给动词加 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 用公式逐个检查：be 和 -ing 少一个都不行。

misconceptions.name: 用 have 表示“某处有”
misconceptions.why: 汉语“附近有一个公园”的“有”直接译成了 have/has。
misconceptions.move: 对比：My town has a park.（谁拥有）There is a park near here.（哪里存在）问：句子的主语是谁？

misconceptions.name: 把“是长头发”说成 is
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“她是长头发”，就用 is 连接 hair。
misconceptions.move: 问：她“是”头发吗？头发、眼睛用 has；高、瘦用 is。

misconceptions.name: 把 hair 当成可数名词
misconceptions.why: 头发可以一根一根数，就以为一头头发也要加 s。
misconceptions.move: 说明：hair 指一头头发时不可数；two hairs 是“两根头发”。

misconceptions.name: 以为疑问句只能用 any
misconceptions.why: 只记住“some 用于肯定句，any 用于疑问句”。
misconceptions.move: 情景对比：Do you have any soup?（问有没有）Would you like some soup?（请对方喝）

misconceptions.name: did 后又用了过去式
misconceptions.why: 知道是过去的事，用了 did，动词又变了一次。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生：did 已经表示过去，后面的动词回到原形。

misconceptions.name: 用 be 动词问实义动词
misconceptions.why: 汉语问“你看见了吗”没有助动词，就把熟悉的 be 放到句首。
misconceptions.move: 问：句子里的动词是 be 还是实义动词？实义动词借助 do、does、did。

misconceptions.name: 不规则动词也加 -ed
misconceptions.why: 把规则动词加 -ed 的办法用到了所有动词上。
misconceptions.move: 列出本单元的不规则动词，两人一组互考：go — went，buy — bought。

misconceptions.name: 过去的事用了动词原形
misconceptions.why: 汉语靠“上周末”这样的词表示过去，动词本身不变。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 last weekend、yesterday，问：这事什么时候发生的？动词要不要变？

items.unit: Unit 1 Can you play the guitar?
items.stem: My sister ____ the piano very well.
right: can 是情态动词，没有人称变化，
后面直接跟动词原形：can play。
typical: 主语 my sister 是三单，动词加 s：
My sister can plays the piano.

ladder.q: 改成一般疑问句：Tom can speak English.

items.unit: Unit 2 What time do you go to school?
lessons: What time do you go to school
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Tom usually ____ (go) to school at 7:30 and ____ (watch) TV after dinner.
right: 主语 Tom 是三单，动词要变；
以 o、ch 结尾的加 es：goes，watches。
typical: “他去上学”和“我去上学”一样，不用变：go，watch

ladder.q: Tom and his brother ____ (brush) their teeth at 9:00.

items.unit: Unit 3 How do you get to school?
lessons: How do you get to school
options: I go to school by the bus.
I take the bus to school.
right: by + 交通工具，中间不加冠词：by bus；
take 后要加冠词：take the bus。
typical: 记得 take the bus，换成 by 也带上 the：
I go to school by the bus.

ladder.q: 改写：I ride my bike to school. = I go to school ____ ____.

items.stem: 小明给班级写了一条规则。你同意这样写吗？
right: late 是形容词，不能直接跟在 Don't 后面，
要加 be：Don't be late for class.

ladder.q: Don't ____ (forget) your homework, and don't ____ late.

items.unit: Unit 5 Why do you like pandas?
items.stem: “因为熊猫可爱，所以我喜欢它们。”哪句对？
options: I like pandas because they're cute.
Because pandas are cute, so I like them.
I like pandas because they cute.
right: because 和 so 只能用一个；
because 后面要跟完整的句子：because they're cute。
typical: Because pandas are cute, so I like them.

ladder.q: 用 so 改写：I like koalas because they're cute.
ladder.a: Koalas are cute, so I like them.

ladder.q: —____ do you like elephants? —Because they're smart.
用 because 说一句：我不喜欢狮子，因为它们很吓人。
ladder.a: I don't like lions because they're scary.

right: Listen! 提示事情正在发生，用现在进行时：
am/is/are + 动词-ing：Mary is singing.

items.unit: Unit 8 Is there a post office near here?
lessons: Is there a post office near here
items.stem: 小明想说“我家附近有一个公园”。他这样写，你同意吗？
work: There has a park near my home.
right: 说“某处有某物”用 there be，不用 have/has：
There is a park near my home.

ladder.q: —____ ____ any restaurants near here? —Yes, there are.

items.unit: Unit 9 What does he look like?
right: 描述头发用 have/has；
hair 指一头头发时不可数：She has long hair.

ladder.q: My father ____ tall and he ____ a big nose.
—What does she look like? —She's thin and ____ (wear) glasses.

items.topic: 请人吃喝：some 还是 any
items.stem: 服务员这样问客人。小红说这句话没有错，你同意吗？
right: 请对方吃、喝，盼着对方说“要”时，疑问句用 some。
问“有没有”时常用 any：Do you have any soup?

ladder.q: Are there ____ tomatoes in the fridge?

items.unit: Unit 11 How was your school trip?
items.stem: —____ you ____ any horses on the farm? —Yes, I did.
right: 实义动词的过去时问句：Did + 主语 + 动词原形，
Did you see any horses?
typical: 过去的事，动词用过去式：

ladder.q: 改成一般疑问句：She took many photos.
改成否定句：They visited a fire station.
ladder.a: They didn't visit a fire station.

items.unit: Unit 12 What did you do last weekend?
lessons: What did you do last weekend
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last weekend I ____ (go) to the beach and ____ (buy) a hat.
right: last weekend 说的是过去，用一般过去时；
go、buy 是不规则动词：went，bought。

ladder.q: We ____ (see) a movie and ____ (eat) pizza last night.
Yesterday they ____ (take) a bus and ____ (get) home at six.
